short_paragraph_benefits: Cacao supports gut health and enhances mood through its high content of flavonoids, magnesium, and gentle stimulants like theobromine. It promotes mental clarity without a crash and helps feed beneficial gut bacteria.

Used traditionally for stamina and vitality, cordyceps enhances cellular energy production (ATP), supports adrenal balance, and helps the body adapt to physical and mental stress—ideal during detox from overstimulation.

Lion’s Mane stimulates Nerve Growth Factor (NGF), aiding in cognitive function, memory, and repair of the nervous system. It also has gut-healing and anti-inflammatory effects that support the gut-brain axis.

Chaga contains powerful antioxidants like melanin and superoxide dismutase that reduce inflammation, combat oxidative stress, and support immune resilience, particularly beneficial for gut lining repair.
Reishi helps regulate cortisol, modulate immune response, and reduce inflammation throughout the body. It's especially effective for those with stress-related gut issues or sleep disturbances.
Guarana provides a sustained release of natural caffeine, reducing withdrawal symptoms from coffee while promoting mental clarity and physical alertness without overstimulating the gut.
Green tea balances caffeine with L-theanine, supporting calm alertness, lowering stress, and providing catechins that feed healthy gut bacteria and reduce inflammation.

Turkey Tail is packed with beta-glucans and polysaccharopeptides that feed beneficial bacteria, enhance mucosal immunity, and support healing of the intestinal wall—crucial during detox and microbiome reset.
Ashwagandha helps lower cortisol, regulate thyroid function, and calm systemic inflammation. It supports the gut by reducing stress-induced digestive issues and improving overall resilience.
